description: This module provides service functions for job-related operations in a backend system, interfacing with a repository layer to list, get, create, update, and delete job postings.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_jobs(db: Session, q: Optional[str], location: Optional[str], limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Lists published jobs with optional search query, location filter, limit, and pagination.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_job(db: Session, job_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific job by its ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_job(db: Session, employer_id: str, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new job posting for an employer with provided data.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_job(db: Session, job_id: str, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing job posting identified by job ID with new data.

methods.name: bool delete_job(db: Session, job_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a job posting identified by its ID.
